title: authoring gate: a page variable whose source names a component the page does not hold, and a visibleWhen reading an undeclared page variable, both pass save and draft diagnostics
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① product defect with reach, two class (a) out-of-scope findings of the #28663 dev (os-dev-report 6560034536), measured on a stock showcase boot. One card for the family (page-variable references the author-time gate does not resolve). Graded by this seat: p2, as its sibling #28663 (same class: the author gets no signal, the page silently misbehaves), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: an author saving a page through the metadata door or Studio.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (the page rules in `packages/lint/src/`, as run by the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` authoring gate; #28663's PR #28723 adds `validate-page-variables.ts`, the natural home).

## What happens

Measured by the #28663 dev on a stock showcase boot, draft read after `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/NAME?mode=draft`:

1. A page variable whose `source` names a component the page does not hold (`variables[0].source = "no_such_component"`): draft `_diagnostics` `valid: true`.
2. A block `visibleWhen` reading an undeclared page variable (`page.nosuch == 'x'`): draft `_diagnostics` `valid: true`.

Neither binding can ever resolve, so the variable never fills and the predicate never reads what the author meant, with no signal at save, draft diagnostics or publish.

## Wanted

- Both are refused (or at minimum reported in draft `_diagnostics`, with publish refused), at the same surfaces the page rules already run on: save, draft diagnostics, publish and `os validate`. One rule each, beside the page-variable rule #28663 adds; ⛔ no second walk.
- Count the existing pages in `examples/**`, `packages/*/src` and the platform apps that would now be refused (expected 0) and put the number in the PR as the migration note.
- `Clause-②: no` (a narrowing; contract review owed), `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`.

## Business reason

A page author (person or AI) who mistypes a component name or a variable name today ships a page whose behaviour quietly differs from what they wrote. Refusing it at save names the mistake where it was made.

Blocked-by: #28663

Dedupe: searched `"page variable" source component` (23 hits) and `undeclared page variable visibleWhen` (40 hits); on topic only #28663, which ruled both out of its scope.
